opening.argument: The presentation ties financial freedom to purchasing a trading package, then directs participants to exchange package tokens for mining slots intended to produce OneCoin. It says that "your package includes the cost of mining for coins" and that participants will profit from OneCoin, while offering payments tied to business volume and matching bonuses through four generations of referrals. Claims of more than 250 millionaires, rapid growth, gold-backing, and stability, together with a signup link, encourage prompt action. The records do not establish the accuracy of those claims, any completed payment, or any resulting loss.
